relevance.rationale: Genuine orphan. It computes twisted Alexander polynomials of finite ABELIAN covers of three-manifolds with torus boundary, generalizing the classical product-over-roots-of-unity formula for the Alexander polynomial of a knot in a finite cyclic branched cover of S^3, in the Reidemeister-torsion framework. I checked for a consumer. The folio does use Reidemeister torsion, but specifically the ADJOINT torsion in the 1-loop-equals-torsion setting (garoufalidis-yoon-2024, pandey-wong-2023 are registered for that), which is a different twisting — the adjoint representation of the geometric SL_2(C) holonomy, not a finite abelian character. The folio's Alexander-polynomial content is ex:threading-link-alexander and neighbouring organic-chemistry blocks on threading links, which use the ordinary multivariable Alexander polynomial and no covers. Grep for branched/abelian/cyclic covers in content/ returns five files, none of which constructs a finite abelian cover whose torsion the folio computes. Same field (torsion invariants of 3-manifolds), no result the folio can consume as it stands. Scope-(a): as read, supplies nothing usable here.

proposedActions.rationale: The folio's torsion usage is adjoint Reidemeister torsion at the geometric representation, already sourced; no block constructs a finite abelian cover for this product formula to apply to.
